title: Once-Weekly GLP-1 Agonist for Glycemic Control in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Tests a once-weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist added to metformin to improve blood glucose control and weight.
inclusion: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes for at least 6 months
exclusion: Insulin use within the past 3 months

title: SGLT2 Inhibitor to Slow Kidney Decline in Type 2 Diabetes With Chronic Kidney Disease
summary: Studies whether an SGLT2 inhibitor slows the loss of kidney function in people with diabetes and kidney disease.

title: Intensive Lifestyle Program for Prediabetes and Obesity
summary: A 12-month diet and exercise coaching program to prevent type 2 diabetes in adults with prediabetes and obesity.

title: Automated Insulin Pump Comparison in Type 1 Diabetes
summary: Compares two automated insulin delivery systems for adults with type 1 diabetes.
inclusion: Type 1 diabetes for at least 1 year

title: Osimertinib Plus Chemotherapy After Progression in EGFR-Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
summary: Tests adding chemotherapy to osimertinib for EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer that progressed on osimertinib.
inclusion: Stage IV non-small cell lung cancer

title: Immunotherapy for PD-L1 High Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Without Driver Mutations
summary: First-line immunotherapy for advanced non-small cell lung cancer with high PD-L1 expression and no EGFR or ALK changes.

title: Follow-Up Imaging After Early-Stage Lung Cancer Surgery
summary: Compared CT schedules after surgery for early-stage lung cancer.
inclusion: Stage I non-small cell lung cancer

title: Sacubitril/Valsartan Dose Optimization in Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
summary: Tests a faster dose-adjustment plan for sacubitril/valsartan in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
inclusion: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
exclusion: Myocardial infarction within the past 3 months

title: Remote Monitoring After Hospitalization for Heart Failure
summary: Home sensor monitoring to prevent readmission after a heart failure hospital stay.
inclusion: Hospitalized for heart failure within the past 30 days

title: Catheter Ablation Versus Drug Therapy for Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Compares catheter ablation with rhythm-control drugs for symptomatic atrial fibrillation.

title: Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy for Hormone Receptor-Positive Breast Cancer
summary: Tests a shorter course of endocrine therapy after surgery for hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.

title: Biologic Therapy for Moderate Asthma
summary: Tests a biologic injection for moderate asthma that is not controlled by inhalers.

title: Home Blood Pressure Monitoring With Pharmacist Support
summary: Pharmacist-led home blood pressure monitoring for adults with uncontrolled hypertension, including people with diabetes.

title: Digital Therapy App for Major Depressive Disorder
summary: Tests a smartphone therapy app for adults with major depressive disorder.

title: Telehealth Coaching for Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Weekly video coaching and glucose tracking for adults with type 2 diabetes.
